source_witness.locus: Bolles translation PDF p22 (A165–A170, Chuen); source parallel PDF pp38-39 columns Kaua/Chan Cah/Pérez
source_witness.paraphrase: Composite colonial Yucatec birth-day source associates people born on Chuen with carpentry, weaving, making, wealth or broad aptitude; wording and intensity vary by manuscript witness.

observable.construct: Time spent doing manual building/weaving/object-making, paid and unpaid; score/source alignment UNFROZEN
question_ids: MAYA-B07-C-HANDS12 (UNFROZEN; original prototype leisure-only undercovers paid craft occupations)
observable.effect_direction: Candidate positive Chuen versus all other signs (UNFROZEN; no participant predictions issued)
observable.falsifier: If a future preregistered independent cohort meets frozen date/measurement eligibility yet Chuen craft outcome is not positively elevated against source-declared null and matched decoys, the preregistered claim fails; variants cannot rescue it.
observable.time_horizon: Past 12 months (candidate retrospective activity report, prospective prediction freeze required)

conditional_exceptions: No verified current Yucatec natal day rollover/epoch/modern continuity
Yucatec Chuen canonical CHUWEN corresponds K'iche' B'ATZ' not the original 1722 K'iche' rule
Historical source occupational traits include paid work but current question prototype excludes work paid under obligation
Question construct and scoring need independent pre-outcome content validity
No actual forward-blind human evidence; original manuscripts not used to calculate participant data

readiness.exclusion_reason: Unverified current regional birth-date cutoff and contradictory type/timing; outcome/prototype alignment and independent review unresolved; no private birth-time engine and chart freeze
readiness.decoy_spec: Draft GMT584283±1,±2,±7,±13,±20,±130 plus GMT584285 sensitivity; commit exact decoy panel, birth-date limits, source and model before answers
readiness.nonastrology_null_spec: Draft age/trade/access/language baselines and cohort chart-label permutation; predeclare matching and ordinal permutation statistic before answers
